tickets.title: Plan course schedule
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to drag and drop courses into a calendar, so that I can see whether my planned courses fit my schedule.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The student can select a course from the course catalog.
- The student can drag the selected course into a calendar.
- The course appears in the selected calendar time slot.
- The student can see the planned course on the calendar.

tickets.title: Check course prerequisites
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want the system to check course prerequisites before I select a course, so that I do not choose a course I am not eligible to take.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system checks the prerequisites of the selected course.
- The system shows whether the student has completed the required prerequisites.
- The system prevents the student from selecting a course when a required prerequisite is missing.

tickets.title: Warn about 8:00 AM classes
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want the system to warn me when I choose a class that starts at 8:00 AM, so that I can avoid scheduling classes that I may have difficulty attending.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system detects when a selected class starts at 8:00 AM.
- The system displays a warning to the student.
- The warning is displayed before the student confirms the course selection.

tickets.title: Override course prerequisite
tickets.description:
As an Administrator/Staff, I want to manually override a prerequisite requirement for a student with special permission, so that the student can take an approved course.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Authorized staff can override a prerequisite for a student.
- The system records that the prerequisite was overridden.
- The override is only available to authorized staff.

tickets.title: View prerequisite information
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to view the prerequisites for a course, so that I can understand what courses I need to complete before taking it.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system displays the prerequisites for the selected course.
- The student can see which required prerequisites have been completed.
- The system clearly indicates any missing prerequisites.

analysis.ambiguity1: The requirement is vague because "stop them from even asking" does not clearly define how the system should prevent students from asking about prerequisite eligibility. It is unclear whether the system should automatically check prerequisites, prevent students from selecting invalid courses, or simply display a warning.
analysis.ambiguity2: The requirement is vague because it does not specify how or when the system should warn students about classes that start at 8:00 AM. It is unclear whether the warning should appear before adding the course, after adding it, or prevent the student from selecting the course.
analysis.conflictSolution: The Registrar wants students to be prevented from adding courses that are full, while the Head of Advising wants students to plan courses four years in advance even when course availability is unknown. The system should separate planning from enrollment. Students should be allowed to add future courses to their four-year roadmap when availability is unknown. During the current enrollment period, the system should check the live database and prevent students from adding courses that are full.
analysis.nfr1: Student schedule data must only be accessible to the student who owns the schedule and authorized university staff.
analysis.nfr2: Performance: The system should respond quickly when checking course prerequisites and course availability.
analysis.nfr3: Usability: The course catalog should provide an easy-to-use interface that allows students to drag and drop courses into a calendar.
